local function split(s, sep)
  local parts = {}

  for match in s:gmatch(pattern) do
    if match ~= "" then
      table.insert(parts, match)
    end
  end
  return parts
end

-- Parse "key=value,key2=value2"
local function parseConfig(s)
  local config = {}
  for pair in s:gmatch("([^,]+)") do
    local key, value = pair:match("([^=]+)=(.+)")
    config[key] = value
  end
  return config
end
